summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/courses POST route and /api/teaching/courses/[courseId]/classes POST route now reject signed teacher cookies whose actorId or sessionId is not a safe server identity before course or class writes can run.

redGreenEvidence.observed: Unsafe course/class actorId cases failed with HTTP 400 because validly signed unsafe actor ids reached later validation. Unsafe course/class sessionId cases failed with HTTP 201 because validly signed unsafe session ids allowed course/class writes.

redGreenEvidence.command: ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/teaching-course-management-api.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed (course|class) create|records redacted request source metadata on signed teacher course creation audits|creates a persisted class under a teacher-owned course"

behaviorHardened: Signed course create cookies whose actorId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed course create cookies whose sessionId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed class create cookies whose actorId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed class create cookies whose sessionId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Unsafe signed identity claims are rejected before course writes, class writes, course-management audit events, or teacher ownership merge callbacks can run.
The denial responses preserve trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.

boundary: This is local backend/API auth-boundary hardening for the main teaching course and class creation routes. It does not replace fresh same-run live production ordinary teaching route/browser smoke artifacts or the aggregate enterprise gate.
